definitionZh: 边框-block-start-color CSS属性定义一个元素的逻辑块-启动边框的颜色,根据元素的写法模式,方向性,以及文本方向,将其映射到物理边框颜色. 它对应边框-上色,边框-右色,边框-下色,或边框-左色属性,取决于为写法模式、方向和文字导向定义的值。
sourceDefinition: The border-block-start-color CSS property defines the color of the logical block-start border of an element, which maps to a physical border color depending on the element's writing mode, directionality, and text orientation. It corresponds to the border-top-color, border-right-color, border-bottom-color, or border-left-color property depending on the values defined for writing-mode, direction, and text-orientation.
